newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares climb on end-month buying.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares climb on end-month buying.

text.p: 1130 GMT - Portuguese shares rose amid the usual end-of-month flurry of buying as investment funds rearranged portfolios, but dealers said the market would switch its attention to U.S. indicators later today.
*May PSI20 futures were up 30 points at 6,219.
*"It's difficult to say whether there would be any business going on at all if it wasn't for the end of the month," said one trader.
*Sonae Industria rose 25 esc to 1,375 on volume of 420,290. The company said it was not behind the heavy trade which amounted to around 2.8 pct of its capital.
*Cimpor climbed 36 esc to 3,668 with 258,919 shares traded.
*BCP shed 2 esc to stand at 2,625 with turnover of 62,841 after earlier hitting a new year high of 2,630.
*BESCL also reached a new high of 3,300 esc, up 40, with 50,489 shares traded.
*Somague rose 16 esc to 1,810 with 67,200 after a Portuguese bank's research group said on Monday that its stock represented a 35 percent discount in terms of price earning ratio.
